Hotel Red Line journey began with a vision to provide top-quality hospitality services to both local and international guests.

With over 25 years of experience in the hospitality industry, our CEO, Tariq Mehmood , has built this hotel with a focus on excellence, ensuring the highest standard of service and comfort for our guests.
The name “ Red Line ” symbolizes our commitment to offering unmatched hospitality that stands out, always striving to go above and beyond for every guest.

At Hotel Red Line, we are dedicated to providing exceptional services, from the quality of our 35 top-tier rooms to the convenience of our various facilities. Whether it’s luxurious accommodations, dining at our in-house restaurant, or holding meetings in our business areas, we aim to exceed expectations.

With our range of modern amenities and personalized services, we ensure every guest enjoys a memorable stay, whether you’re here for a short visit or an extended stay. The nearby attractions and facilities make Hotel Red Line the perfect base to explore both cities.
Join us for a truly comfortable and welcoming experience where your satisfaction is our top priority.

reviews.text: Great place great people. Stayed twice recently check in was smooth handed us keys before settling room price. Staff was very friendly and helpful to move stuff in and out of the building. Had security guard watching our cars parked outside of the building. Check in around evening time person on reception desk was very nice and friendly will definitely recommend. ☺️

This Hotel is interesting. All of the front desk staff, the bellboys, security, and the owner were very accommodating to me and I appreciate them very much. Unfortunately as an American traveller, the inconsistent wifi (strong when it was working but not always working) and the power going out multiple times a day (no tv, had to charge phone in the hotel lobby) was completely unacceptable. Hot water for showers is not available until after 7pm.

The room was clean, furniture was nice. The price is very very cheap. If they can get their wifi and power situation under control, I will give this hotel 10 stars.

I checked in at Redline Hotel on 5 February at 11:00 PM for one night. My stay was extremely unpleasant due to continuous loud noise from the lobby at 3:00 AM, followed again at 7:30 AM, caused by staff speaking loudly with no regard for guests.

When I contacted reception, they denied any noise. I then went to the desk and requested the manager, but was told the manager was unavailable. The staff were unprofessional, dismissive, and unwilling to take responsibility, insisting the customer was wrong.

This hotel failed to provide basic comfort, quiet, and professional service. I do not recommend it.

I spent a really good time at this hotel.
The ambiance is great and very welcoming.
Rooms are clean, spacious, and comfortable.
There’s no noise pollution, which made it very relaxing.
Overall, it was a peaceful and enjoyable stay.

I had a great stay at Hotel Red Line last year in summer. When I traveled to Pakistan and Iam  planing once again to stay here while i will travel to Pakistan next month .The room was clean and cozy, and the staff was super friendly and helpful. Definitely good value for the price!
Only thing about parking . Not so much space for parking.

I recently stayed at redline hotel and wanted to share some feedback. While I appreciated the good breakfast and comfortable room temperature, I was disappointed with certain aspects of my stay.

Cleanliness: The room service and cleaning were below expectations. There was a persistent bad smell in the bathrooms, and during the morning cleaning of other rooms, the corridors were filled with an unpleasant odor. Washrooms were not tidy as well.

I hope you can address these concerns to improve the experience for future guests.

I booked 2 rooms in Redline hotel on my recent visit to Islamabad with family. My experience was amazingly so good with hotel and their staff. I was in contact with their owner and shift manager throughout the entire booking process and trust me their dealing made it so easier.
While my stay time there, i felt secure within and even outside the hotel premises.
Staff was available 24/7 and always ready to serve in case of any request from ourside.
Good thing about hotel is that it is near to Motorway approach, so it is a good spot for travelers to stay there.
Food was cooked with heart. Breakfast was good though.
Overall i am very satisfied and highly recommended facility.

I checked out the Red Line Hotel and let me tell you, it's 🔥! The moment you step into the lobby, you're greeted with a vibrant and modern atmosphere. The staff is super friendly and always ready to assist you with a big smile. The rooms are cozy and stylishly decorated, making you feel right at home.

One of the highlights of the hotel is the rooftop pool. It offers breathtaking views of the city skyline, and it's the perfect spot to relax and soak up the sun. And if you're a foodie like me, you'll be thrilled with the delicious options at the hotel's restaurant. From mouthwatering breakfasts to gourmet dinners, they've got it all covered.

The location is also a major plus. Situated in the heart of the city, you'll find yourself just steps away from the best attractions, shops, and restaurants. It's so convenient!

Overall, I would definitely recommend the Red Line Hotel for an amazing stay. It's a combination of comfort, style, and great service. I hope you get the chance to experience it yourself! 😄🏨

I booked a room at Hotel Red Line for a 1-night emergency stay with my family after seeing it on Booking.com, where the price was listed as 6,000 to 7,000 per night. However, when I arrived, the bearded manager at the counter charged me 8,200, claiming it was a "discounted price."

I was given a standard room, but the manager insisted it was a deluxe room, which seemed like an attempt to overcharge me. The overall experience was disappointing, and one of the staff members made an inappropriate comment, which added to the discomfort.

I would not recommend this hotel, especially for emergency stays, as it felt unprofessional and unwelcoming.
